calls.video_title: Why Is BigBear.ai Stock Crashing, and is it a Buying Opportunity? | BBAI Stock Analysis
calls.thesis: First tracked Parke BBAI stance: NOT a buying opportunity even after -61% YTD. Revenue falling ($160M peak to $132M TTM), government contract cuts, cash flow/sales at record low -54%; DCF $1.90 vs $2.11 market = fairly valued to slightly overvalued. Getting closer as price falls, but not there yet.
calls.bull_case: $321M cash/short-term investments — no need to raise capital soon; a revenue-growth turnaround or further price fall could make it a buy.
calls.bear_case: More government-contract cuts, acquisition spending keeps bleeding margins, and eventual dilution when the cash buffer runs out.
